final.answer:
Create an aware datetime by passing a tzinfo (e.g. datetime.timezone.utc or a custom tzinfo subclass) to the constructor or by using datetime.now(tz). Then call .astimezone(target_tz) to convert it. Example:
```python
import datetime as dt
# aware datetime in UTC
now_utc = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
# convert to US/Eastern (fixed‑offset example)
eastern = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=-5))
now_eastern = now_utc.astimezone(eastern)
print(now_utc, now_eastern)
```

harness.answer:
Create an aware datetime by passing a tzinfo (e.g. datetime.timezone.utc or a custom tzinfo subclass) to the constructor or by using datetime.now(tz). Then call .astimezone(target_tz) to convert it. Example:
```python
import datetime as dt
# aware datetime in UTC
now_utc = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
# convert to US/Eastern (fixed‑offset example)
eastern = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=-5))
now_eastern = now_utc.astimezone(eastern)
print(now_utc, now_eastern)
```
